why: A checkerboard is periodic and infinitely sharp: a match onto the wrong square agrees with as
many neighbours as a match onto the right one, so a registration accuracy measured there is a
statement about a scene no lens will ever see. Phase 2's number is only worth quoting if the
world it was measured in is a photograph (ADR 0059).
Every file beside this one is copied here byte for byte from where it was found, and every
field below is a fact a reader can check: `tools/asset_provenance.py` fails the build if a file
here has no entry, if an entry is missing a field, or if the bytes no longer hash to what is
recorded. A licence written down once and never checked again is a licence nobody can rely on.
`width` and `height` are the two recorded facts that checker cannot verify without an image
library; `tools/test_synth_dataset.py` verifies them where Pillow is already present.

notes: CC0 is a public-domain dedication: no attribution is required and derivatives carry no

HDRI, which is what makes it readable here at all — the .hdr original is 26 MB and needs a
decoder no dependency of this repository has.
